why: The specs were written with the socket tools on the right arm. Power Suits swapped the arms (2026-10-13) by mirroring the whole model, so bb.mjs mirrors the model back for the specs and mirrors their output onto the live rig.
ankle_why: Legs v10 (booted, 2026-10-15). Since 2026-11-10 the legs are footless (empty foot bone): plant() ignores this range and keeps the foot bone at 0 (k2.js FOOTLESS); kept for the booted specs (a_walk_v6.js, a_run_v8.js) on older models.
